describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal, low-slung animal shown in right-facing profile walking on a flat light surface against a plain off-white background. Its body is robust and arched, almost entirely covered in large overlapping rounded scales that are brown with darker centers and tan edges, with irregular patches of larger pale pink speckled scales on the mid-flank, lower side and shoulder. It has an elongated pointed snout with a dark nostril at the tip, a small glossy black eye, and four thick limbs ending in clawed feet. A long, thick, tapering scaly tail extends to the left rear, and six pink fleshy stalks bearing dense feathery red-pink filaments protrude from the sides and top of the head and neck just behind the ear openings.

describe.description: A quadrupedal animal shown in right profile walking to the right with an arched back. The back, sides, top of the head, tail and upper legs are covered in overlapping rounded brown scales interspersed with patches of larger pale pink speckled scales. It has an elongated tapered head ending in a pointed snout with a dark nostril, a small round black eye, fine whiskers, and a small dark ear opening. Four short thick wrinkled legs with broad clawed feet support the body. A long tapering scaly tail extends to the left rear and is partially cropped. Six pink branched stalks fringed with fine red feathery filaments protrude from the neck just behind the head, three visible on the near side and three peeking over the top of the head from the far side.
